name: warehouse-management-system
description: Warehouse management system dashboard: stock value and utilisation, ageing and ABC classes, replenishment cover, storage cost, an in-browser CBM calculator and inbound commitments. Static React and TypeScript, seeded synthetic data, 2,493 reconciliation checks. Live demo included.

paragraphs: A warehouse management system dashboard for a fictional engineering group, every figure from one seeded generator.
features: 47 material groups across a multi-vertical roster (one vertical is deliberately empty), each carrying its own dimensions, price, demand and twelve months of stock history.
One shared CBM rule drives the generator, the reconciliation script and the browser's live calculator, so a manual edit and a published figure can never disagree.
2,493 of 2,493 reconciliation assertions pass, independently re-checked against the written JSON files rather than the generator's own memory, with the result published on the Data basis page.
50 published data files are byte-identical across two runs of the same seed, because every stamped timestamp is fixed to one recorded instant rather than the clock time of the build.
188 of 188 interaction checks pass against a real served build in a real browser: table sorting, chart view switches, a full keyboard traversal, and hostile-input handling on every calculator field.

whatItDoes.text: A warehouse management system dashboard for a fictional engineering group, every figure from one seeded generator.

requirements.text: Percentages are one decimal, computed from the summed totals rather than from other percentages, and any set of shares that must total 100.0 (ABC classes, value shares, age-band splits, the month's cost allocation) is assigned by largest remainder so it always does.
